guides.title: Asli ya nakli WiFi? 3 check, 3 second
guides.summary: Public jagah (airport, cafe, station) pe same naam ke do WiFi dikhein, to connect karne se pehle ye 3 check karo.

steps.title: Naam match karo
steps.body: WiFi ka exact naam staff se poocho ya official board/receipt pe dekho. Ek letter bhi alag (jaise Airp0rt with zero) to wo nakli hai. Do same naam dikhein to staff se confirm kiye bina connect mat karo.

steps.title: Login page dekho
steps.body: Asli public WiFi aam taur pe sirf mobile number + OTP ya room/ticket number maangta hai. Agar login page bank password, card number, UPI PIN ya email password maange, turant band karo. Wo nakli page hai.

steps.title: Browser warning ko serious lo
steps.body: Agar browser 'Your connection is not private' ya 'Not secure' dikhaye, to 'Go back' dabao. 'Proceed' kabhi mat dabao.

steps.title: Galti se connect ho gaya?
steps.body: Phone ki WiFi settings mein us network pe tap karke 'Forget' karo. Jo bhi password daala tha, wo turant badlo, aur us account mein 2-step verification on karo.

guides.tip: Bahar banking ya payments sirf mobile data pe karo. Free WiFi sirf browsing aur reels ke liye.
guides.caution: Ye general safety guide hai. Kisi bhi fraud pe turant apne bank ko call karo aur cybercrime.gov.in ya helpline 1930 pe report karo.

guides.title: Free airport WiFi: WiFi nahi, jaal?
guides.summary: Bina password wala free WiFi kabhi kabhi nakli hotspot hota hai jo aapke passwords chura sakta hai. Bachne ka simple rule.

steps.title: Samjho khatra kya hai
steps.body: Koi bhi same naam ka hotspot bana sakta hai (jaise Free_Airport_WiFi_Fast). Connect hote hi wo nakli login page dikha kar aapka password le sakta hai.

steps.title: Banking sirf mobile data pe
steps.body: Public jagah pe UPI, net banking ya shopping payments sirf apne mobile data pe karo.

steps.title: Auto-connect band karo
steps.body: Phone settings mein WiFi ke andar 'Auto-join' / 'Auto reconnect' open networks ke liye band karo, taaki phone khud nakli WiFi se na jude.

steps.title: Asli WiFi pehchano
steps.body: Part 2 dekho: naam, login page aur browser warning, ye 3 check.

guides.tip: Free WiFi = sirf reels. Paisa = mobile data.
guides.caution: Ye general safety guide hai. Fraud ho to turant bank ko call karo aur 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.
